response.title: PFMS payment failure handling and re-initiation
response.description: The system shall record the PFMS failure reason, notify the applicant by SMS to correct bank details within 30 days, re-validate the Aadhaar-seeded bank account through PFMS, and include the application in the next weekly payment batch.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a PFMS payment fails due to an unseeded, closed, or frozen account, when the weekly batch is processed, then the system records the failure reason, sends an SMS notification to the applicant to correct bank details, and queues the application for re-initiation in the subsequent weekly batch.
response.rationale: The existing FR-PAY-001 and FR-PAY-003 requirements address only successful credit, and ANS-1 mandates a 30-day notification window and weekly batch re-initiation for failed DBT payments.
